name: Sasaki Shōta
source: Shōta is a son of two famous Japanese actors. Despite that, all he really wants is to have a normal high school life. A social butterfly with a natural aptitude for arts and sports; he tries participating in all extracurricular activities, often draggingMC around in an attempt to help fight her shyness.
